annotations.title: Read the Vendor Offer (The Door's Window)

description: Read the ComOS network's vendor offer — public and read-only, no token needed. Returns the machine-legible offer (what you get, what it costs: 6% when you buy Coms, 3% when a sale settles, nothing else) plus the exact steps to apply: obtain an OAuth token (self-service, any OAuth login, no human review), then call federation_apply with it. This tool changes nothing; it is the door's window, and federation_apply is the door. Returns: { offer: <vendor manifest — the same document as /.well-known/comos-vendor.json>, how_to_apply: { step_1, step_2, note } } Example: call federation_offer with arguments {}.

channel.description: Optional: where you found us (e.g. moltbook, registry:mcp.so, direct). Arrival telemetry only — the offer content never varies by channel.

name: federation_offer
